summary: Implemented the certified-path pre-registration gate: CertifiedRun in harness/run.py (create/open, propose, evaluate with run_config conformance, single judge with mid-battery fail-closed consume, seal + run_manifest.json), pluggable anchors in harness/anchor.py (NoopAnchor, FileAnchor, GitAnchor), and harness/verify.py (invariants 1–9 raw-first replay/recompute + CLI). harness/__init__.py exports the new public surface. Tests cover the three bypasses (scope-shrink, direction flip, trace tamper), §6 honesty window, all three anchors, and CLI exit codes (36 new tests).
